Stack

A layout primitive for stacking elements vertically or horizontally with consistent spacing between items.

Vertical Stack

Use .zak-stack to stack items vertically with uniform gap spacing.

Stack Item 1
Stack Item 2
Stack Item 3
HTML
<div class="zak-stack">
  <div>Stack Item 1</div>
  <div>Stack Item 2</div>
  <div>Stack Item 3</div>
</div>

CSS Reference

HTML
.zak-stack {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.zak-stack-horizontal {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
}

.zak-stack-xs { gap: 0.25rem; }
.zak-stack-sm { gap: 0.5rem; }
.zak-stack-md { gap: 1rem; }
.zak-stack-lg { gap: 1.5rem; }
.zak-stack-xl { gap: 2rem; }

.zak-stack-divided > * + * {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--zak-border);
}

Accessibility

  • Stacks are purely layout components with no semantic meaning — use appropriate HTML elements inside
  • Divided stacks use CSS borders, not ARIA separators — screen readers won't announce them
  • Ensure stacked items have sufficient visual spacing for touch targets (minimum 44x44px)
